sections.section_content:
message authentication
The following figure shows a typical operation for authenticated encryption or decryption,
and for cipher-based message authentication.
[Figure 195. Typical operation with authentication]
Section28.4.11: SAES Galois/counter mode (GCM) and Section28.4.13: SAES counter
with CBC-MAC (CCM) describe detailed sequences supported by SAES.
Cipher-based message authentication flow omits the payload phase, as shown in the figure.
Detailed sequence supported by SAES is described in Section28.4.12: SAES Galois
message authentication code (GMAC).
